subject: Longview renewal — cloud channel onramp & co-sell runway
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@longview.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Longview renewal — cloud channel onramp & co-sell runway

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the catch-up last week. Longview's renewal is coming up in June and you mentioned interest in moving billing to the cloud channel (AWS Marketplace or Azure Marketplace) to align procurement and enable co-sell credits.

Quick proposal to keep things simple and low-risk:
- Convert the existing subscription to an equivalent Marketplace SKU at renewal (no change to seat counts or core entitlements).
- Apply a one-time marketplace onboarding credit to offset switching paperwork during the first month.
- Run a co-sell enablement checklist with your AE to capture GTM opportunities once the contract is live.

Two asks from your side to get the ball rolling:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact for terms/signature (if different from this thread).
2) Share any internal requirements for invoice format/PO flow so we can map to marketplace invoices.

I attached a short two-page onramp plan that outlines timelines and the amendment we typically use.

If it's easier, we can schedule a 30-min call with Procurement + Finance to walk through the amendment and expected invoice snapshots.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Longview_MA_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@longview.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Longview renewal — cloud channel onramp & co-sell runway

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the outline. Renewal is currently managed by our procurement team but happy to evaluate channel billing — good for our internal chargeback. A couple questions before we loop Procurement: 

1) Will the marketplace invoice match our current line-level breakdown (base subscription + add-ons)? We need line items for internal cost allocation.
2) Any impact to current SSO/SAML or data residency terms? We need to ensure no regressions.
3) Marketplace pricing — do we keep the same committed rate or is there a marketplace list/discount to expect?

Procurement contact is procurement@longview.ai (I cc'd them). If you can send the amendment draft and a sample marketplace invoice, we can share with our Finance folks.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Partnerships, Longview Analytics
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Longview renewal — channel onramp questions

Posting Olivia's questions here so we can align on asks before we send procurement-facing materials. Key items:

- Invoice line items: finance needs to confirm we can export the same PO/line breakdown from marketplace billing. Marcus: can Redwood emit itemized lines and PO refs on AWS/Azure invoices?
- Entitlements: Laura — Longview flagged SSO and data residency. Do we need an SLA amendment or will existing enterprise terms remain intact?
- Pricing: Aditya — Longview expects the same committed rate; would we accommodate a marketplace SKU that preserves customer unit price plus a short onboarding credit? Suggest 10% one-time credit on first invoice to smooth.

Attaching draft amendment for review — please add comments and I'll loop Olivia/procurement afterward.

[Attachment: Longview_amendment_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks —
Stephanie

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Longview renewal — channel onramp questions

Stephanie — quick answers: 

- Marketplace invoices (AWS & Azure) can include PO references and line items; we map SKUs to our internal line breakdown and include metadata fields for PO# and customer account. I'll attach a sample PDF snippet when I send to Olivia.
- No change to SSO/SAML or data residency — channel billing doesn't change the existing deployment or control plane for Private/Dedicated customers. Any contractual language remains in the amendment. Laura, confirm if we should include an explicit call-out clause to avoid confusion.
- Pricing model: we can preserve committed unit pricing by mapping to a custom marketplace SKU and then apply an onboarding credit off-invoice. Aditya will confirm the commercial sign-off on the credit.

I'll prepare the sample invoice and a short note for procurement.

— Marcus

Subject: Amendment & sample invoice — Longview renewal (for Procurement)

Hi Procurement team —

Per Olivia's request, attaching the draft amendment and a sample marketplace invoice that shows PO fields and line-level detail. Highlights: 
- We maintain the same committed pricing mapped to a marketplace SKU.
- We will apply a one-time onboarding credit of 10% on the first invoice to offset administrative switching costs.
- No changes to SSO/SAML or data residency; the amendment preserves existing enterprise terms.

Please review the attachment and reply with any edits. If it's helpful, we can schedule a 30-min procurement walk-through next week (I am available Tue/Wed morning PT).

Attachments:
- Longview_amendment_draft.docx
- sample_marketplace_invoice_snippet.pdf

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Thanks, Stephanie — procurement reviewed and Finance is comfortable with the line-item example. We agree to the 10% onboarding credit and preserving current entitlements.
